description: Use this tool when a user asks for an actual price or quote to ship a car, SUV, pickup, van or minivan between two locations in the 48 continental US states - e.g. "How much to ship my car?", "Get an auto transport quote", "Cost to move my SUV from California to Texas". Returns a real, bookable quote from CarHauler247, a licensed auto transport broker: the Industry Standard market-based starting price (not guaranteed, may change) and, when available, the guaranteed Price & Dates Lock price - plus distance, driving time and a booking link that opens the quote pre-filled. Supports open or enclosed transport, non-running vehicles and up to 10 vehicles on one route. Requires pickup, delivery and either vehicle_type (one vehicle, or several of the same) or vehicle_list. For several different vehicles, put them all in vehicle_list in ONE call - it returns one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Pass year/make/model when the user mentions them, but never ask for a trim. Do not use for unrelated freight, household moving or general automotive questions.

delivery.description: Delivery location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "78701" or "Austin, TX".

enclosed.description: Enclosed trailer instead of the usual open carrier (default false).

inoperable.description: The vehicle doesn't run or drive (default false).

model.description: Model, if known, e.g. "RAV4". No trim needed.

pickup.description: Pickup location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "95117" or "San Jose, CA".

ship_date.description: Earliest pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 4 days from today).

vehicle_list.description: Several vehicles on the same route, e.g. a 2008 Lexus GS 350 and a 2003 Honda Accord - all in one call for one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Use instead of vehicle_type/year/make/model/vehicles.

vehicle_type.description: Optional when make and model are given.
Body type. Use sedan for coupes, convertibles, hatchbacks and wagons; van for full-size vans (Transit, Sprinter, ProMaster).

vehicles.description: Number of vehicles of this kind on the same route (default 1). For different vehicles use vehicle_list instead.

name: get_car_shipping_quote

drive_time.description: Pure driving time for the distance; delivery usually takes a few days longer because carriers make other stops.

guaranteed.description: false: price is a market-based starting price, not guaranteed - it may need to be raised to get a carrier.

lock_unavailable_reasons.description: Why Price & Dates Lock isn't available, when price_lock is missing.

message.description: The answer in words, ready to relay to the user.

plan.description: The plan price is for: Industry Standard.

price.description: Industry Standard starting price in USD for all the vehicles together.

price_factors.description: What moves the price most, in dollars (negative lowers it) - mention only when the user asks why or what affects the price.

applies_to.description: route, order, or the vehicle it's about, e.g. 2019 Toyota 4Runner

price_label.description: Show next to price as is: 'Market-based starting price - may change'.

price_lock.description: Only when Price & Dates Lock is available: the guaranteed price - the price and the pickup window are guaranteed (say 'included', not 'available'). Show it next to the Industry Standard price, with its own booking link.

price.description: Guaranteed price in USD for all the vehicles together.

price_label.description: Show next to this price as is: 'Price & Dates Lock included'.

status.description: quoted: a price is included. not_available: no price - message explains why (e.g. Alaska/Hawaii need marine transport, unknown location, missing details).

title: Get car shipping quote
